# Factictionary (factictionary.in)

> Factictionary is an independent software studio and web utility platform building 85+ 100% client-side, privacy-first browser tools (WebAssembly PDF, Image, Audio, Video, eBook, Office, and KDP publishing utilities), 14 offline-capable Android applications & games on the Google Play Store, and 13 comprehensive technical handbooks.

## Official Profiles & Storefronts
- Website: https://factictionary.in/
- Google Play Developer Portfolio (14 Android Apps): https://play.google.com/store/apps/developer?id=Factictionary
- Web Utilities Hub (85+ Client-Side Tools): https://factictionary.in/tools/
- Evergreen Pillar Guides (13 Handbooks): https://factictionary.in/guides/
- Android Apps Showcase: https://factictionary.in/games/
- Digital eBook & Template Store: https://factictionary.in/shop/
- Technical Glossary: https://factictionary.in/glossary/

## Featured In-Browser Web Utilities (100% Client-Side, Zero Server Uploads)
- [Online EPUB eBook Reader & Inspector](https://factictionary.in/tools/epub_reader.html): Open and read .epub files in browser with Sepia/Dark mode and TTS audio with zero file uploads.
- [Online DOCX Word Viewer & Clean HTML Converter](https://factictionary.in/tools/docx_viewer.html): View Microsoft Word .docx files and export clean HTML/text with zero file uploads.
- [Online Excel (.XLSX) & CSV Spreadsheet Viewer](https://factictionary.in/tools/excel_csv_viewer.html): Open, filter, and convert .xlsx and .csv files to JSON locally with zero file uploads.
- [Online CBZ Comic & ZIP Image Reader](https://factictionary.in/tools/cbz_comic_reader.html): Read .cbz comics and manga in Webtoon vertical scroll or single-page mode.
- [Online Tambola / Housie 1-90 Caller & Ticket Generator](https://factictionary.in/tools/tambola_caller.html): Call numbers 1–90 with voice nicknames and generate printable 3x9 tickets.
- [Free Online Teleprompter & Speech Pacing Timer](https://factictionary.in/tools/online_teleprompter.html): Browser teleprompter with eye-line band, mirror flip, and WPM calculator.
- [Google Play 12 Testers / 14 Days Closed Testing Calculator](https://factictionary.in/tools/play_store_tester_tracker.html): Calculate Day-15 Production Access dates and generate Play Console review answers.
- [Online 9x9 Sudoku Playable Grid & Instant Solver](https://factictionary.in/tools/sudoku_water_sort.html): Play 9x9 Sudoku or solve any grid instantly via constraint backtracking.
- [Tuition & Coaching Fee Receipt Generator](https://factictionary.in/tools/tuition_fee_receipt_generator.html): Generate printable student fee receipts and WhatsApp payment confirmations.
- [ATS Resume Matcher & Keyword Analyzer](https://factictionary.in/tools/ats_resume_matcher.html): Compare resumes against job descriptions locally in browser RAM.
- [Client-Side PDF Merger & Combiner](https://factictionary.in/tools/pdf_merger.html): Combine, rotate, and reorder PDF files locally with zero file uploads.
- [Client-Side PDF Compressor](https://factictionary.in/tools/pdf_compressor.html): Shrink PDF file sizes in browser memory without cloud uploads.
- [Private Browser PDF OCR](https://factictionary.in/tools/pdf_ocr.html): Extract selectable text from scanned PDFs locally.
- [KDP Cover & Spine PDF Generator](https://factictionary.in/tools/kdp_cover_generator.html): Generate print-ready Amazon KDP paperback cover templates.
- [KDP Royalty & Printing Cost Calculator](https://factictionary.in/tools/kdp_royalty_calculator.html): Calculate Amazon KDP printing fees and net royalties.

## 14 Official Android Apps on Google Play (Developer: Factictionary)
- [Test Pilot Pro - 12T/14D](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.factictionary.test_pilot_pro): Pass Google Play's mandatory 12 testers for 14 days closed testing requirement.
- [All-In-One Tambola & Housie](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.factictionary.virtual_tambola): Digital Tambola tickets, auto-daub, and paperless family/kitty party Housie.
- [Tambola & Housie Host Caller](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.factictionary.tambola_housie_host): Automated voice number caller and claim verifier for Tambola hosts.
- [Chalkly: Tutor, Tests & Fees](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.factictionary.chalkly): Coaching batch fee tracker, test generator, and math/science formula vault.
- [Teleprompter & AI Speech Coach](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.factictionary.speak_smart): Floating camera teleprompter for recording confident Reels, Shorts, and presentations.
- [ShortsFX - Reel & Status Maker](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.factictionary.shortsfx): Fast 9:16 vertical video templates and status maker.
- [Quizziest: Trivia & Detective](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.factictionary.quizziest): 60-second crime scene detective riddles, logic puzzles, and trivia rounds.
- [VocabIQ: Crossword & Wordle](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.factictionary.crosssearch): 6-in-1 offline daily word puzzle suite.
- [Puzzle Mania: WaterSort & Sudoku](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.factictionary.puzzle_mania_offline): 100% offline Water Sort color puzzles and 9x9 Sudoku.
- [MindBites: 2-Min Daily Digest](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.factictionary.mind_bites): Bite-sized 2-minute daily non-fiction learning cards.
- [Lingofy: AI Language & Speak](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.factictionary.lingofy.twa): Learn 12 languages across 25 travel & life categories with native audio.
- [Duo Cards: Crazy 8s & Mau Mau](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.factictionary.uno_card_game): Offline 4-color shedding card game with Wild 8s and action combos.
- [Stack Blitz: 3D Tower Builder](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.factictionary.stack_blitz): Fast-paced 3D block stacking arcade game across 10 worlds.
- [Giggl: Daily Comics & Humor](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.factictionary.spoof_daily): Clean daily comic strips, jokes, and witty comebacks.
